notes.title: EA v0.2! Content and Stability!
notes.content:
We're a little late on the update today, but here's what we got for everyone:

[u][b]Early Access Update v0.2![/b][/u]

[b]New Minigame: Keep Away[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36928395/1d2416f571ae87e5cec955e5cb03fcc6d6b31e9a.gif[/img]

A very simple yet fun 2v2 mini game. Hold onto the ball the longest. Pass the ball to your teammate if you are in trouble.

[b]New Item: Spear[/b]

This one comes with 3 charges. Throw them at infinite range in a line. Now you can reach your friends even if they are on the other side of the map.

[b]Adjusted Item: Mushroom -> Poison Mushroom.[/b]

Mushrooms now give a bit less movement, but deal damage. We want items to have more potential interaction as well as a wide range of outcomes. Now anyone that you pass by you deal damage to, setting up some cool combos.

[b]New feature: Damage drops gold[/b]

Any damage will drop gold. We'll be watching and adjusting the balance on this. We want players to use items even if they can't guarantee a kill, at least they can try to steal gold

[b]Crystal Hunters -> Paper Hunters[/b]

New artwork for the favorite shotgun map, and the thematic has taken us a little closer to home.

[b]Major Stability Updates / Bug fixes / Quality of Life improvements:[/b]
- Black screen creation bug: Fixed
- New message when a player disconnects
- Reduced file size and memory size
- Capped FPS at 60 for improved performance across the board. Fewer wasted frames, better consistency.
- Fixed GPU hits on Danger Room map
- Fixed issue when playing with controller that would force the map to move constantly into the upper left
- Improved camera zoom location to actually be over your character
- Fixed an invisible wall on Cave of Wonders that you could get stuck behind
- Removed footsteps from Cave of Wonders
- Set 60s turn timer to default to fix issues of AFK players
- Added the "this is you" to Submarines to better recognize who you are

notes.title: New Mini-Game: Crystal Hunters Update!
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

We decided to push this out a bit earlier as the mini-game is about ready, but other parts of the planned patch might be delayed due to some stability work that we need to prioritize. We hope to have new map items and another new mini game out in 10 days or so.

[b]New Mini-Game: Crystal Hunters[/b]

Crystal Hunters is a top down shotgun game where you gather crystals. The player with the most crystals at the end of the match wins. There is limited visibility, and only 1 bullet between reloads. Turn in crystals in the middle to keep them safe from dropping on death.

[i]Mini games will first be patched in as "beta" mode to gather feedback, and also to give quicker updates while we work on polishing the game.[/i]

[b]New Image Messages[/b]

When you right click the ground on the board game, you now have options of images from top twitch used emotes.

[b]New visualization for current goblets[/b]

[i]It wasn't always clear how many goblets were required to win, so we updated the visualization[/i]

[b]AI Bomb: Updated movement from 4 spaces to 5 per turn. Fixed a typo on the description that read 6.[/b]

[i]4 Spaces felt not quite far enough, while 6 had situations where if you played it on the end of the round, it would travel half the map before anyone had a chance to move. We're trying 5 to see how balanced and fun it feels.[/i]

[b]Updated some space locations on board game[/b]

[b]Stability Updates:[/b]

Fixed bug that the game would not initialize properly sometimes.
Fixed issues with visualization to throwing bombs and where they would land.
Fixed bugs with timers of mini games counting correctly.
Fixed issue with Archery not always starting correctly.
